title: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Responds to Dermal Chelation
brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical trial is to identify 50 participants with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) and follow their total white blood cell (WBC) counts and absolute lymphocyte counts after performing dermal chelation and administering nutritional therapy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia and has a toxic heavy metal load
* Toxic heavy metal load

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Pacemaker implants
* Organ transplant recipients
* Psychotic episodes or epileptic seizures
